rows.t: I'm moving into my first flat with an induction hob. Which pans do I actually need to start with, and which can wait?
Is this frying pan's coating PTFE-free? I've read worrying things about non-stick and I don't know what to believe.
Will the casserole fit in a standard oven with the lid on? I need the height including the knob.
Is the hand-hammered copper range worth three times the price of the stainless one, or is it just for show?
I want my first espresso machine. I drink two flat whites a day and I've never steamed milk.
How much electricity does the machine use if I leave it on standby?
I have arthritis. I need a kettle I can fill, lift and pour without much grip.
Is the toaster wide enough for sourdough slices?
Which descaler is safe for this espresso machine? I don't want to void the warranty.
Is there a subscription for descaler and filters so I never run out?
I need a wedding present from their list, under a hundred pounds, that will still be in their kitchen in ten years.
I love the green enamel colour. What else comes in it?
Is the sale price on the casserole actually lower than usual?
How long will it last? I want to buy one good set rather than replace cheap pans every two years.
Where is the cookware made and under what conditions?
I want to send it straight to the couple with a gift note and no price inside.
Can I pay for the espresso machine in instalments without a credit check?
Which delivery option is cheapest and still arrives before the weekend?
Can I collect from a shop instead of having a heavy box left on the doorstep?
The non-stick coating is wearing off after three months. Am I using the wrong utensils?
How do I descale the machine without damaging it?
My espresso tastes sour. Is it the beans, the grind or the machine?
My grandmother left me her copper pans. Can they be re-tinned, and what would it cost?
Time to reorder the water filters. Same ones as last time.
The kettle lid hinge has snapped. Is that covered?
I want the same machine for my brother. I can't remember which model it was.
How do I dispose of an old toaster safely? Can it go in the bin?
Is the 14-day return period from when I ordered or when it arrived?
How often should I season the cast-iron pan, and with what oil?
Can I use oat milk in the frother, or will it damage it?
